pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chart-funnel against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-chart-funnel id="c" label="Воронка заказа" stage="step" value="people" value-format="integer"></sf-chart-funnel>
<sf-chart-funnel id="g" label="Регистрация" stage="step" value="n" value-format="integer" table="hidden"></sf-chart-funnel>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the stages are one group described by the stages' count, the range, the overall conversion and the largest loss; each stage after the first writes its share of the one before; the bars shorten stage by stage
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.conversion, settings.summary

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"visit": "Визиты", "catalog": "Каталог", "cart": "Корзина", "checkout": "Оформление", "paid": "Оплата"}; c.items = [{"step": "visit", "people": 12400}, {"step": "catalog", "people": 7800}, {"step": "cart", "people": 2900}, {"step": "checkout", "people": 1300}, {"step": "paid", "people": 860}]; document.querySelector('#g').items = [{"step": "Открыли форму", "n": 5200}, {"step": "Ввели почту", "n": 3100}, {"step": "Подтвердили", "n": null}, {"step": "Заполнили профиль", "n": 1400}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#c figure'); const t = document.querySelector('#c [role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(t.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' '); const shares = [...document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-funnel-share')].map((one) => one.textContent.replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' ').trim()); const bars = [...document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-funnel-bar')].map((one) => one.getBoundingClientRect().width); return f && document.getElementById(f.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Воронка заказа' && t.getAttribute('aria-roledescription') === 'воронка' && /^Этапов: 5, от 12 400 до 860, итоговая конверсия 6,9 ?%\. Больше всего теряется между «Каталог» и «Корзина»: дальше проходит 37,2 ?%\.$/u.test(d) && shares.join('|').replace(/ /gu, '') === '|62,9%|37,2%|44,8%|66,2%' && bars.length === 5 && bars.every((w, i) => i === 0 || w < bars[i - 1]); })()

checks.title: the arrows walk the stages, each move said with its value and both conversions; Enter chooses a stage; Escape clears
checks.covers: keyboard.host (ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter, Escape), events.select

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"visit": "Визиты", "catalog": "Каталог", "cart": "Корзина", "checkout": "Оформление", "paid": "Оплата"}; c.items = [{"step": "visit", "people": 12400}, {"step": "catalog", "people": 7800}, {"step": "cart", "people": 2900}, {"step": "checkout", "people": 1300}, {"step": "paid", "people": 860}]; document.querySelector('#g').items = [{"step": "Открыли форму", "n": 5200}, {"step": "Ввели почту", "n": 3100}, {"step": "Подтвердили", "n": null}, {"step": "Заполнили профиль", "n": 1400}]; return true; })()

(() => { window.__chosen = null; document.querySelector('#c').addEventListener('sf-chart-funnel-select', (event) => { window.__chosen = event.detail; }); document.querySelector('#c [role=group]').focus(); return true; })()

checks.title: a stage with no value is a gap: no bar, an outlined track, said in the summary; the stage after it has no conversion from it, and the table keeps every row

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"visit": "Визиты", "catalog": "Каталог", "cart": "Корзина", "checkout": "Оформление", "paid": "Оплата"}; c.items = [{"step": "visit", "people": 12400}, {"step": "catalog", "people": 7800}, {"step": "cart", "people": 2900}, {"step": "checkout", "people": 1300}, {"step": "paid", "people": 860}]; document.querySelector('#g').items = [{"step": "Открыли форму", "n": 5200}, {"step": "Ввели почту", "n": 3100}, {"step": "Подтвердили", "n": null}, {"step": "Заполнили профиль", "n": 1400}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#g [role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(t.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' '); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#g table tbody tr')].map((row) => [...row.children].map((cell) => cell.textContent.trim().replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' ')).join('|')); return document.querySelectorAll('#g .sf-chart-funnel-bar').length === 3 && document.querySelectorAll('#g .sf-chart-funnel-stage--gap').length === 1 && /Нет данных: 1\.$/u.test(d) && rows.length === 4 && /^Заполнили профиль\|1 400\|нет данных\|26,9 ?%$/u.test(rows[3]); })()

checks.title: the error state offers a retry that sends refresh

steps.script: (() => { const button = document.querySelector('#e sf-empty-state button'); if (button) button.click(); return true; })()
